body: UNH suit vs CMS/HHS over 2027 MA star ratings: claims 26 measures improperly used across 45 contracts, correct calc would lift ratings ~0.5-1.5 stars; at least the 15th plan to sue; no ruling (Modern Healthcare; Healthcare Finance News; Medical Daily). CMS proposed rule CRUSH (CMS-6098-P): provider enrollment screening, expanded MA-plan fraud reporting, ~$90B 10-yr savings claimed; comments due 19-Jan-2027 (Becker's; Reuters via Capital.com). Size of insurer share move conflicts across sources (2-5% vs UNH -10.2%) - unverified.
title: UnitedHealth sues CMS over 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings (~20-Nov-2026); CMS proposes CRUSH anti-fraud rule (~16-Nov-2026)
